messages:
Morgan: Dropping a focused review thread for the Embeddings & Rerank panel. Key asks: clearer CSV mapping UX, vector-sampling preview (no full float dumps on screen), and a friendly export manifest that explains what gets exported. Figma: https://figma.com/file/EMB-RERANK-V4.

Keri: Quick wins: 1) In the uploader mapping step show a compact preview of 3 example rows (first/med/last) so users can verify parsing. 2) Add a "skip row if parse error" toggle with a visible count of skipped rows.

Tomas: For vector preview, we should show only a condensed histogram of norms + top-3 neighbors with small thumbnails (if available). No full vectors rendered client-side. Offer a "Download sample vectors (NDJSON)" button that downloads 10 rows.

Jin: UX: in the relevance table, add a tiny chevron to expand a row to an inspector panel (keyboard focusable) that shows the top neighbors, score breakdown, and model metadata (model id, quantization). Keep the table dense by default.

Sana: Accessibility: mapping modal must expose column headers programmatically and let screen reader users step through mapping options. Example aria text: "Map CSV column 'col_3' to query text. Current sample: 'How to connect DB'". Also require that the export confirm dialog has role=alertdialog and lists approximate file size.

Priya: Copy suggestion for export manifest: heading "Export manifest". Body: "This export includes: IDs, queries, relevance scores, model metadata. Raw vectors are optional and may be large. For large jobs we will stream gzipped NDJSON and email a download link when ready." Buttons: "Export summary" / "Export raw (NDJSON gz)".

Keri: Small interaction nit: when users toggle 'include raw vectors', show an inline estimate: "~52MB (5,000 rows, 768 dims)" and a tooltip that explains assumptions. Also provide a link to "Estimate my export" that opens a calculator.

Tomas: Backend note from infra: we can emit an export manifest JSON like:
```
{"job_id":"e-123","rows_requested":5000,"rows_exported":4998,"includes_vectors":true,"file_type":"ndjson.gz","estimated_size_bytes":54872000}
```
This could be shown in UI and attached to download emails.

Jin: Regarding rerank jobs: show a running-state badge when rerank is using approximate scoring and flip to "exact" when finished. Also allow users to pin a particular model version so re-run uses identical model metadata.

Sana: Keyboard flows to validate: 1) open uploader -> map columns -> preview sample -> start job -> focus lands on job list and announcement reads "Rerank job started". 2) open row inspector -> tab through actions -> Esc closes inspector. I'll run NVDA and VoiceOver tests after next mock.

Priya: Microcopy tweak: replace "Export raw" with "Export raw vectors (NDJSON, gz)" to be explicit. For the manifest heading use: "Export manifest — what will be included".

designbot: Created task <#design-board-789> "Embeddings UI: mapping preview + export manifest" assigned to Keri, Tomas, Priya, Sana. Due: 4 days.

buildbot: Note: API rate-limit for export jobs is 2 concurrent per user, throttled at 1/s for manifest checks.

Morgan: Great input. Action list: - Keri to add sample-row preview to mapping modal - Tomas to design condensed vector preview + inspector - Priya to finalise export manifest copy and inline size estimates - Sana to run a11y test pass on the modal flows - Jin to wire the inspector expand state and model pin. Please post screenshots and a short keyboard walkthrough here when ready. :thumbsup:
